name: Zooming Interaction Model
aliases: Shift of center of the object
Shift of the center of the object
definition: A camera transformation model for zooming that shifts the center of the object to emphasize user attention on focus parts near the initial button click.
summary: The Zooming Interaction Model shifts the rendered object's center during zooming to emphasize user attention on focus parts near the initial click, differing from uniform scaling by applying semantic-dependent translation.
